'''Material Procedures''' was a branch of [[Situational Enforcement/Legends|Situational Enforcement]], part of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Security Division]]. They tracked all reports of property damage to Authority equipment and facilities. Material Procedures had two branches; [[Embezzlement]] and [[Industrial Espionage (Material Procedures)|Industrial Espionage]].<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
